data.short_description: Brew Lab Café is a new coffee shop offering Vietnamese coffee, fruit teas, milk teas, espresso drinks, mochi donuts, and Taiwanese chicken. It will soft open on Saturday, June 13th from 8am to 3pm at 1949 Silas Deane Highway in Rocky Hill, previously home to a Dunkin. The shop is owned by Trung Ho and Thao Tran.

data.status: final day of operation will be June 14th
data.short_description: Plan B Burger Bar is a locally owned burger restaurant chain located at 1638 Boston Post Road in Milford, part of the Milford Marketplace shopping center. The restaurant's final day of operation will be June 14th according to staff. The chain originally opened in Milford in the fall of 2011 and has closed numerous other locations in prior years; after this closure, two locations in Simsbury and Glastonbury will remain.

O'Reilly Auto Parts is an auto parts retailer that has leased the former Casa Vallarta Mexican Restaurant space at Five Town Plaza for a new Springfield location. The space is located at 300 Cooley Street in Springfield and would be roughly 7,500 square feet; it is unclear whether they will reuse the existing building or demolish and rebuild. This would be the third Springfield location for O'Reilly Auto Parts, with other locations on State Street and Liberty Street.

data.status: last day will be this Monday, June 8th
data.short_description: 5CB, formerly known as Five Churches Brewing, is a brewery located at 193 Arch Street in New Britain that has announced its pending closure after 8 years of business. The brewery's last day will be Monday, June 8th, and they are offering $5 pours of any beer that weekend to close out the chapter. The brewery opened in 2018 as Five Churches Brewing and changed its name to 5CB in 2025 following a legal dispute with a Georgia restaurant over the name.

Dollar Tree is a dollar store chain constructing a new Manchester location at 430 Buckland Hills Drive, near Walmart, with signage recently installed and interior fit-out progressing. The new store will occupy roughly 12,000 square feet and is expected to relocate from The Plaza at Buckland Hills to this new location later this summer. Renovation is underway including a new interior and refreshed exterior with the chain's signature green paint color accents.

data.status: Look for them to reopen soon
data.short_description: Namco Pools is a pool and recreation retailer finishing work on a new space at 440 Buckland Hills Drive in Manchester, next to Mattress Firm. The new space is described as roughly half the size of their previous location. The article notes they are putting the finishing touches on and to look for them to reopen soon.

data.location: North Main Street and Riverside Avenue, Bristol, Connecticut
data.short_description: The Cornerstone is a proposed 6-story mixed-use development by Carrier Homes planned for the corner of North Main Street and Riverside Avenue in Bristol, featuring 70 residential units, 5,000 square feet of retail/commercial space, and covered parking. According to the Mayor's office, the parcel will be sold for $250,000 and receive a standard 7-year tax abatement. The development is on the site of the former Mall at Bristol Centre, which operated until 2005 and was demolished in 2008.
